WITH snap AS (
  SELECT om.maintcost,
         om.mtbfh,
         om.mttrh,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.snapts - p.goliveon)) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
)
SELECT AVG(maintcost / (total_hours / mtbfh)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost
FROM snap
WHERE mtbfh > 0
  AND total_hours > 0
  AND mttrh / (mtbfh + mttrh) > 0.05

SELECT SUM(pm.degyrrate * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss
FROM plants p
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
WHERE pm.degyrrate * 20 > 14

SELECT LOWER(pm.pnlkind) AS panel_kind,
       AVG(((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric
            - (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric)
           / (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor
FROM electrical_performance ep
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v' IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v' IS NOT NULL
  AND (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric > 0
GROUP BY LOWER(pm.pnlkind)
ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC

SELECT p.sitelabel, p.warrclaims
FROM plants p
WHERE p.warrclaims > 2
  AND LOWER(p.warrstate) = 'claimed'
ORDER BY p.warrclaims DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(om.mttrh)::numeric, 2) AS avg_mean_time_to_repair
FROM plant_record pr
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
WHERE (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct')::numeric
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.snapts) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.goliveon), 0) > 0.5

SELECT ROUND((om.mttrh / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))::numeric, 4) AS system_unavailability
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
WHERE LOWER(p.sitelabel) = 'solar plant west davidport'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(om.maintcost / (17520.0 / om.mtbfh))::numeric, 0) AS mean_repair_cost
FROM operational_metrics om
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
WHERE LOWER(pm.pnlkind) = 'hjt'
  AND om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL
  AND om.mtbfh > 0

SELECT ROUND(AVG((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_initial')::numeric
                 - (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_now')::numeric), 3) AS avg_fill_factor_degradation
FROM electrical_performance ep
JOIN mechanical_condition mc ON mc.snapmk = ep.snaplink
WHERE LOWER(mc.mech_health_snapshot->'module_surface'->>'busbar_corrosion') = 'severe'
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_initial' IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_now' IS NOT NULL
